title.zh-CN: 间断脐周痛、血小板计数很高 · 5岁女孩
title.en: Intermittent periumbilical pain and a very high platelet count · 5-year-old girl

summary.zh-CN: 5岁女孩肚脐周围间断疼痛10天，验血发现血小板计数很高；静脉抗感染治疗后疼痛稍减，收入儿科病房进一步检查。
summary.en: A 5-year-old girl with ten days of on-and-off pain around her umbilicus and a very high platelet count on a blood test is admitted to the children's ward for further tests after IV antibiotics eased the pain a little.

notes.zh-CN: 依据一篇已发表的单例报告改写。患者事实沿用1.0.0版从报告中提取的内容：年龄、性别、10天脐周间断疼痛、无诱因、无发热流涕、无黏膜出血和消化道症状、入院前抗感染治疗后的变化、既往健康和生长发育、家族史、查体、两次血常规、CRP、凝血、骨髓涂片和活检、JAK2、融合基因、核型、报告的治疗、治疗第2天的惊厥和MRI、第15天和5个月的血小板及腹痛转归；尚未对照原文全文核对。患者为化名，医院、日历日期和身份细节已去除，时间以病程天数和治疗天数表示。陪同家属的具体身份、对话、阶段、决策、处置选项、评分、教学要点和医护人物是教学设计；没有记录的内容（生命体征、血红蛋白和血涂片、VWF、铁代谢、腹部影像、药物剂量、惊厥细节、MRI序列）保持未知。保留的不一致与含糊之处：两次血常规的日期没有记录（分诊记录把1905×10⁹/L写作此前的结果）；“治疗中第2天”“15天”的起算日没有说明；“增强MRI”没有写部位和序列；网状纤维用报告的“±”记法。
notes.en: Adapted from one published case report. The patient facts are those extracted for version 1.0.0: age, sex, 10 days of intermittent periumbilical pain with no trigger, no fever or rhinorrhoea, no mucosal bleeding or bowel symptoms, the change after antibiotics before admission, past health and growth, family history, the examination, two blood counts, CRP, clotting, marrow smear and trephine, JAK2, fusion tests, karyotype, the report's treatment, the seizure on treatment day 2 and its MRI, and the platelets and pain at day 15 and over 5 months; they have not yet been checked against the full article. The patient has a pseudonym; hospitals, calendar dates and identifying details are removed, and times are days of illness or of treatment. Which relative accompanies her, the dialogue, phases, decisions, management options, scoring, teaching points and staff are teaching design; what the case does not record (vital signs, haemoglobin and the film, VWF, iron studies, abdominal imaging, drug doses, the seizure's details, the MRI sequences) stays unknown. Inconsistencies and ambiguities kept: the dates of the two counts are not recorded (the triage note gives 1905 × 10⁹/L as an earlier result); “day 2 of treatment” and “15 days” do not say where they count from; the “contrast MRI” has no region or sequences; reticulin keeps the report's “±” notation.

disclaimer.zh-CN: 历史病例回看，仅供临床教育，不用于个体诊疗或自行用药。病程和结果均来自原报告，不模拟未记录的生理变化。
disclaimer.en: Historical case review for clinical education, not for individual care or self-medication. The course and results come from the report; unrecorded physiological changes are not simulated.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 鉴别儿童反应性与原发性血小板增多：抗感染后仍持续超过1000×10⁹/L、CRP<8 mg/L、脾可触及、白细胞升高时，安排血涂片、铁代谢、BCR::ABL1、驱动基因和骨髓检查（GTH/GPOH 2021；BSH 2010）。
learningOutcomes.en: Tell reactive from primary thrombocytosis in a child — a count above 1000 × 10⁹/L that outlasts antibiotics, a CRP below 8 mg/L, a palpable spleen and a raised white count — and plan the film, iron studies, BCR::ABL1, driver mutations and marrow (GTH/GPOH 2021; BSH 2010).

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 在VWF活性明确之前，对极高血小板计数的孩子暂缓阿司匹林，解释获得性血管性血友病综合征的机制，并在按血栓处理腹痛之前先做腹部多普勒超声（Tiede等，2011）。
learningOutcomes.en: Hold aspirin at an extreme platelet count until von Willebrand factor activity is known, explain acquired von Willebrand syndrome, and image the abdominal veins with Doppler ultrasound before treating abdominal pain as thrombosis (Tiede et al., 2011).

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 按WHO第5版（2022）标准判读JAK2 V617F阳性、BCR::ABL1阴性的骨髓结果，说明区分原发性血小板增多症、真性红细胞增多症和纤维化前期骨髓纤维化还需要什么。
learningOutcomes.en: Apply the WHO 5th edition (2022) criteria to a JAK2 V617F-positive, BCR::ABL1-negative marrow and say what is still needed to separate essential thrombocythaemia from polycythaemia vera and prefibrotic myelofibrosis.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 与儿童血液科一起，依据成人证据（ELN 2018；Tefferi 2024；PT-1，2005）为年幼儿童选择一种一线降细胞药（羟基脲或干扰素α，不两药并用），并就阿司匹林、瑞氏综合征、非甾体抗炎药和疫苗接种给家属具体建议。
learningOutcomes.en: Choose, with paediatric haematology and from adult evidence (ELN 2018; Tefferi 2024; PT-1, 2005), one first-line cytoreductive drug for a young child — hydroxyurea or interferon-α, not both — and give the family specific advice on aspirin, Reye's syndrome, NSAIDs and vaccination.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 把骨髓增殖性肿瘤患儿新出现的无热惊厥当作可能的卒中或静脉窦血栓处理：血糖、血象和凝血，暂停抗血小板药，当天做含血管成像的MRI（RCPCH 2017）。
learningOutcomes.en: Manage a new afebrile seizure in a child with a myeloproliferative neoplasm as a possible stroke or venous sinus thrombosis: glucose, count and clotting, antiplatelet drugs held, a same-day MRI with vascular sequences (RCPCH 2017).

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 用Calgary–Cambridge的分段说明和回授法，向孩子的家属解释一种需要长期随访的血液病，并说明这例报告的病程能说明什么、不能说明什么。
learningOutcomes.en: Explain a long-term blood disorder to a child's family with Calgary–Cambridge chunking and teach-back, including what this report's course can and cannot show.

chiefComplaint.zh-CN: 肚脐周围一阵一阵地疼了10天，验血发现血小板很高
chiefComplaint.en: Pain around her belly button on and off for 10 days, and a blood test showed very high platelets

triageNote.zh-CN: 5岁女孩，由家属陪同收入儿科病房。脐周间断疼痛10天，无明显诱因，同期化验发现血小板计数很高，记录到的一次为1905×10⁹/L。入院前静脉用过抗感染药，腹痛稍减轻，血常规无明显变化。
triageNote.en: 5-year-old girl admitted to the children's ward with a relative. Ten days of intermittent periumbilical pain with no obvious trigger, and a very high platelet count found over the same period (one recorded count 1905 × 10⁹/L). IV antibiotics before admission eased the pain a little without changing the blood count.

tags.zh-CN: 抗感染治疗后血象无变化

personality.zh-CN: 5岁女孩，以前一直健康，神志清楚、一般情况好；在医院里有点怕生，能指出哪里疼，回答“现在疼不疼”这类简单问题。
personality.en: A 5-year-old who has always been healthy, alert and generally well; a little shy in hospital, she can point to where it hurts and answer simple questions such as whether it hurts now.

speechStyle.zh-CN: 孩子说短句、用小孩的说法；家属回答大部分问题，用日常口语，不用医学术语，记不清的就直说。
speechStyle.en: The girl speaks in short, childlike sentences; her relative answers most questions in everyday words, without medical terms, and says so when something has slipped their mind.

openingLine.zh-CN: （清和指着肚脐周围）这儿疼……一会儿疼，一会儿又不疼了。
openingLine.en: (Qinghe points around her belly button) It hurts here… it comes and then it goes away.

concerns.zh-CN: 她血小板这么高，是不是血液里有什么大毛病？
concerns.en: Her platelets are so high — could something be badly wrong with her blood?

actingNotes.zh-CN: 扮演者：孩子只回答直接问她的简单问题（哪里疼、现在疼不疼），其余由家属回答。入院时她神志清楚、一般情况好，肚脐周围一阵阵疼。家属着急但配合，只讲自己知道的事；化验数值、骨髓和基因结果、诊断都由医生说。治疗第2天的惊厥只在病例进入那个阶段后才表现：家属很害怕，只能说时间很短、没有发烧，别的细节说不上来。不知道的事就直说不知道，不要编。
actingNotes.en: For the actor: the girl answers only simple questions put to her (where it hurts, whether it hurts now); her relative answers the rest. On admission she is alert and generally well, with on-and-off pain around her belly button. The relative is worried but cooperative and says only what they know; numbers, marrow and gene results and the diagnosis are for the doctors. The seizure on treatment day 2 shows only once the case reaches that phase: the relative is frightened and can say only that it was short and without fever. Whatever they do not know they say so plainly and never invent.

persona.zh-CN: 清和的近亲属，陪她住院；具体是哪位亲属不清楚，不要另加设定。着急、心疼孩子，但愿意配合；用日常口语回答，只讲自己知道或听医生说过的事；数字记不住就直说，不替医生下结论。
persona.en: A close relative who is staying with Qinghe in hospital; which relative is not known, so add nothing. Worried and protective but cooperative; answers in everyday words, saying only what they know or have heard from the doctors; admits forgetting numbers and draws no medical conclusions.

description.zh-CN: 清和肚脐周围间断疼痛已经10天，同期化验发现血小板计数很高；入院前用过静脉抗感染药。向她和家属问病史、给她查体、看最初的化验，决定先查什么、先防什么。
description.en: Qinghe has had on-and-off pain around her umbilicus for 10 days and a very high platelet count over the same period; she had IV antibiotics before admission. Take the history from her and her relative, examine her, read the first results, and decide what to look for and what to guard against first.

text.zh-CN: 报告的诊断为学龄前期发病的儿童原发性血小板增多症；JAK2 V617位点G/T杂合，即V617F突变。治疗给予羟基脲、干扰素和阿司匹林等；剂量、开始日期和先后顺序本病例没有记录。治疗第2天出现一次短暂的无热惊厥，增强MRI未见异常。到第15天血小板降至559×10⁹/L；随访5个月，血小板220–390×10⁹/L，未再腹痛。本病例没有记录惊厥的原因、是否做过VWF检测和腹部影像、有无出血或血栓、药物不良反应以及5个月以后的随访；单个病例也不能说明惊厥的机制或疗效能否持久。
text.en: The report's diagnosis is childhood essential thrombocythaemia with onset in the preschool years; its JAK2 result (G/T at V617) is the V617F mutation. Treatment included hydroxyurea, interferon and aspirin, among others; the doses, start days and order are not recorded in this case. A brief afebrile seizure occurred on treatment day 2, and a contrast-enhanced MRI showed no abnormality. By day 15 the platelet count had fallen to 559 × 10⁹/L; over 5 months of follow-up it was 220–390 × 10⁹/L and the abdominal pain did not return. The case does not record the cause of the seizure, whether VWF tests or abdominal imaging were done, any bleeding or thrombosis, drug side effects, or follow-up beyond 5 months; a single case cannot establish the seizure's mechanism or whether the response lasts.

source.zh-CN: 报告病例资料·诊断、治疗与随访（儿童原发性血小板增多症；羟基脲、干扰素和阿司匹林等；治疗第2天短暂无热惊厥，增强MRI未见异常；15天血小板559×10⁹/L，5个月220–390×10⁹/L，无再腹痛）（1.0.0版提取，待对照原文核对）

name.en: Insert an IV cannula and take bloods

dose.zh-CN: 外周静脉留置针，同时留取血标本。
dose.en: A peripheral IV cannula, taking the blood samples at the same time.

response.zh-CN: 已建立静脉通路并留取血标本。本病例没有记录是否做过这一步；不模拟其效果。
response.en: IV access is in and the bloods are taken. This case does not record whether this was done; it does not simulate its effect.

name.zh-CN: 当天请儿童血液科会诊

dose.zh-CN: 当天电话联系儿童血液科：交代两次血常规、凝血结果和查体，商定检查顺序，以及由谁决定抗血小板药和降细胞治疗。
dose.en: Phone paediatric haematology today: give them both counts, the clotting results and the examination, and agree the order of the tests and who decides on antiplatelet and cytoreductive drugs.

response.zh-CN: 儿童血液科医生已知情，今天会来看她。本病例没有记录会诊的经过；不模拟其效果。
response.en: The paediatric haematology team has been told and will see her today. This case does not record a consultation; it does not simulate its effect.

name.zh-CN: 医嘱单注明：暂不用阿司匹林及非甾体抗炎药
name.en: Chart alert: no aspirin or NSAIDs for now

dose.zh-CN: 在医嘱单和护理记录上注明：VWF结果出来、血液科同意之前不用阿司匹林、布洛芬等抗血小板或非甾体抗炎药。
dose.en: Write on the drug chart and in the nursing notes: no aspirin, ibuprofen or other antiplatelet or anti-inflammatory drug until the VWF results are back and haematology agree.

response.zh-CN: 医嘱单上已注明暂不用阿司匹林和非甾体抗炎药。本病例没有记录是否做过这一步；不模拟其效果。
response.en: The chart now says no aspirin or NSAIDs for the time being. This case does not record whether this was done; it does not simulate its effect.

dose.zh-CN: 口服，每日1次，按体重给予抗血小板剂量。
dose.en: By mouth once daily at an antiplatelet dose by weight.

harm.zh-CN: 她的血小板1905和1497×10⁹/L，APTT 52.3 s尚未解释，本病例任何时候都没有VWF结果。血小板超过1000×10⁹/L时可丢失大分子VWF多聚体（获得性血管性血友病综合征），这时阿司匹林会带来严重出血风险：先测VWF活性，瑞斯托霉素辅因子活性高于30%时才可用阿司匹林，否则先把血小板降下来（Tiede等，Blood 2011；Stockklausner等，Ann Hematol 2021）。16岁以下儿童只有在有明确指征时才用阿司匹林（英国MHRA，2003），因为有瑞氏综合征的风险。
harm.en: Her platelets were 1905 and 1497 × 10⁹/L, the APTT of 52.3 s is unexplained, and no VWF result is recorded at any point in this case. Above 1000 × 10⁹/L the largest VWF multimers can be lost (acquired von Willebrand syndrome), and aspirin then carries a serious bleeding risk: measure VWF activity first, and give aspirin only if ristocetin cofactor activity is above 30 %, otherwise after the count has been lowered (Tiede et al., Blood 2011; Stockklausner et al., Ann Hematol 2021). In a child under 16, aspirin is used only for a specific indication (UK MHRA, 2003), because of Reye's syndrome.

response.zh-CN: 已给阿司匹林。报告记录她用过阿司匹林，但没有记录开始的时间、剂量和当时的血小板计数；不模拟其效果。
response.en: Aspirin given. The report records that she received aspirin, but not when it started, at what dose or at what count; the case does not simulate its effect.

dose.zh-CN: 皮下注射，每日1次，按体重给予预防剂量。
dose.en: By subcutaneous injection once daily at a prophylactic dose by weight.

harm.zh-CN: 本病例没有任何影像证实的血栓，APTT 52.3 s尚未解释，VWF活性未知：不做影像就抗凝，只会增加出血风险，治疗的却是未经证实的血栓。内脏静脉或颅内静脉血栓要先用影像证实，再与儿童血液科一起制定抗凝方案（Tefferi等，Am J Hematol 2024）。
harm.en: No clot is shown on imaging at any point in this case, the APTT of 52.3 s is unexplained and VWF activity is unknown: anticoagulation without imaging adds bleeding risk to treat a clot nobody has shown. Splanchnic or cerebral venous thrombosis is shown on imaging first, and anticoagulation is then planned with paediatric haematology (Tefferi et al., Am J Hematol 2024).

response.zh-CN: 本病例没有记录用过肝素；不模拟其后果。
response.en: This case does not record any heparin; it does not simulate the consequences.

name.zh-CN: 再用一个疗程的静脉抗生素
name.en: A further course of IV antibiotics

dose.zh-CN: 静脉滴注广谱抗生素，按体重给药，针对“腹腔感染”。
dose.en: A broad-spectrum IV antibiotic by weight for a presumed abdominal infection.

harm.zh-CN: 她没有发热，CRP<8 mg/L，第一个疗程后血象也没有变化：没有任何线索提示需要治疗的感染，而抗菌药只在患者临床上确实需要时才开始（英国UKHSA《Start smart then focus》，2023）。再用抗生素会增加不良反应和耐药，还会推迟对原发病因的检查。
harm.en: She has no fever, a CRP below 8 mg/L and a count the first course did not change: nothing points to an infection to treat, and antimicrobials start only when a patient clinically needs them (Start smart then focus, UKHSA 2023). More antibiotics add side effects and resistance, and delay the search for a primary cause.

response.zh-CN: 本病例没有记录入院后再用抗生素；不模拟其后果。
response.en: This case does not record a further course after admission; it does not simulate the consequences.

dose.zh-CN: 每周1次皮下注射；剂量按体表面积，由儿童血液科确定并随访甲状腺功能、情绪、血常规和肝功能。
dose.en: Subcutaneous injection once a week; the dose by body surface area, set by paediatric haematology, who also follow thyroid function, mood, blood counts and liver tests.

harm.zh-CN: 降细胞治疗要等骨髓、BCR::ABL1和驱动基因结果确定诊断之后再开始；两种降细胞药同时用会叠加骨髓抑制和不良反应，没有证据显示获益更大——成人指南都是选一种一线药（Tefferi等，Am J Hematol 2024）。
harm.en: Cytoreduction waits until the marrow, BCR::ABL1 and driver-mutation results have established the diagnosis, and two cytoreductive drugs together add marrow suppression and side effects with no evidence of greater benefit — adult guidance starts one first-line drug (Tefferi et al., Am J Hematol 2024).

response.zh-CN: 已开始干扰素α。报告记录她用过干扰素（制剂、剂量和开始日期没有记录），此外还用过羟基脲和阿司匹林；不模拟其效果。
response.en: Interferon-α started. The report records that she received interferon (preparation, dose and start day not recorded), as well as hydroxyurea and aspirin; the case does not simulate its effect.

dose.zh-CN: 口服，每日1次，剂量按体重由儿童血液科确定，定期复查血常规。
dose.en: By mouth once daily, the dose by weight set by paediatric haematology, with regular blood counts.

harm.zh-CN: 降细胞治疗要等诊断确定之后再开始；已经在用干扰素α时再加羟基脲，会叠加骨髓抑制，没有证据显示获益更大（Tefferi等，Am J Hematol 2024）。
harm.en: Cytoreduction waits until the diagnosis is established, and adding hydroxycarbamide to interferon-α adds marrow suppression with no evidence of greater benefit (Tefferi et al., Am J Hematol 2024).

response.zh-CN: 已开始羟基脲。报告记录她用过羟基脲（剂量和开始日期没有记录），此外还用过干扰素和阿司匹林；不模拟其效果。
response.en: Hydroxycarbamide started. The report records that she received hydroxyurea (dose and start day not recorded), as well as interferon and aspirin; the case does not simulate its effect.

dose.zh-CN: 由血液科和输血科决定；儿童需要中心静脉通路。
dose.en: Decided by haematology and transfusion medicine; a child needs central venous access.

response.zh-CN: 本病例没有记录单采；不模拟其效果。血小板单采用于计数极高同时有急性血栓或出血的情况，由血液科决定；5岁孩子做单采需要中心静脉通路。
response.en: This case does not record apheresis; it does not simulate its effect. Plateletpheresis is kept for acute thrombosis or bleeding with an extreme count, decided by the haematology team; in a 5-year-old it needs central venous access.

name.zh-CN: 向家属说明诊断和治疗计划
name.en: Explain the diagnosis and the plan to her family

dose.zh-CN: 由血液科医生和护士一起谈：骨髓里血小板生成过多是怎么回事、为什么要降血小板、药物的作用和不良反应、需要长期随访；书面交代：不自行用阿司匹林或布洛芬；如果用上阿司匹林，出水痘或流感时停药并就诊（瑞氏综合征）；按时接种疫苗，用药期间接种水痘等减毒活疫苗前先问血液科，每年接种灭活流感疫苗——服用阿司匹林期间不用鼻喷减毒活疫苗；出血、剧烈头痛、抽搐或腹痛加重时立即就诊。也用孩子听得懂的话告诉清和。
dose.en: With the haematologist and the nurse: what it means that her marrow makes too many platelets, why the count must come down, what the medicines do and their side effects, and that follow-up is long-term; in writing: no aspirin or ibuprofen unless prescribed; if aspirin is started, stop it and call during chickenpox or flu (Reye's syndrome); keep vaccinations up to date, asking haematology before any live vaccine (such as chickenpox) while she is on these drugs, with a yearly inactivated flu vaccine — not the live nasal one while she takes aspirin; come straight back for bleeding, a severe headache, a fit or worse tummy pain. Tell Qinghe too, in words she understands.

response.zh-CN: 谈话已经完成。本病例没有记录医生对家属说了什么；不模拟其效果。
response.en: The conversation has taken place. This case does not record what the family was told; it does not simulate its effect.

dose.zh-CN: 检查气道、呼吸和循环，侧卧位，需要时吸氧；记录再次发作的时间和表现。
dose.en: Check airway, breathing and circulation, recovery position, oxygen if needed; time and describe any further seizure.

response.zh-CN: 已检查气道并让她侧卧。本病例没有记录是否做过这一步；不模拟其效果。
response.en: Her airway is checked and she is in the recovery position. This case does not record whether this was done; it does not simulate its effect.

dose.zh-CN: 电话联系儿童神经科当天会诊，共同决定影像检查、脑电图和是否需要抗癫痫药。
dose.en: Phone paediatric neurology for a same-day review and agree the imaging, an EEG and whether any antiseizure drug is needed.

response.zh-CN: 儿童神经科医生已知情，今天会来看她。本病例没有记录神经科会诊；不模拟其效果。
response.en: Paediatric neurology has been told and will see her today. This case does not record a neurology review; it does not simulate its effect.

name.zh-CN: 静脉左乙拉西坦负荷量

dose.zh-CN: 静脉滴注，按体重给予负荷量。
dose.en: IV infusion, a loading dose by weight.

harm.zh-CN: 一次短暂、已经停止的惊厥，在原因查清之前不需要立即用抗癫痫药——紧急抗癫痫治疗针对持续5分钟及以上的发作（NICE NG217，2022）；紧急的是找原因——血糖、血象、凝血和当天的脑影像（RCPCH 2017）。先用药再把影像推后，可能漏掉需要处理的血栓或出血。
harm.en: One brief seizure that has stopped does not call for an antiseizure drug before its cause is known — emergency antiseizure treatment is for seizures lasting 5 minutes or more (NICE NG217, 2022); what is urgent is finding the cause — glucose, the count, clotting and same-day brain imaging (RCPCH 2017). Giving the drug and putting the imaging off can miss a clot or a bleed that needs treatment.

response.zh-CN: 本病例没有记录用过抗癫痫药；不模拟其后果。
response.en: This case does not record any antiseizure drug; it does not simulate the consequences.

title.en: Take the history from her and her relative

hint.zh-CN: 她的腹痛有什么特点？之前的治疗改变了什么、又没改变什么？家里有没有类似的情况？
hint.en: What is her pain like? What did the earlier treatment change — and what did it not? Is there anything similar in the family?

guidance.zh-CN: 到床旁，向清和和陪同的家属了解情况。
guidance.en: Go to the bedside and take the history from Qinghe and her relative.

hint.zh-CN: 哪些体征能提示出血、血栓，或者血小板这么高的原因？
hint.en: Which signs could point to bleeding, to a clot, or to the cause of a count this high?

title.zh-CN: 读懂最初的化验，决定先做什么
title.en: Read the first results and decide what comes first

hint.zh-CN: 什么会让血小板一直这么高？在开任何药之前，你需要先弄清楚什么？
hint.en: What can keep a platelet count this high — and what do you need to know before you prescribe anything?

guidance.zh-CN: 开出入院检查，在会诊板作答决策1和决策2，落实决策2选定的检查和医嘱，并请儿童血液科参与。
guidance.en: Send the admission tests, answer decisions 1 and 2 on the case board, carry out the tests and orders decision 2 calls for, and involve paediatric haematology.

title.en: Interpret the marrow and genetic results

hint.zh-CN: 这些结果能确定什么？要把诊断最终定下来，还缺哪些证据？
hint.en: What do these results settle, and what evidence is still missing before the label is final?

guidance.zh-CN: 住院检查阶段：调阅骨髓涂片、骨髓活检、基因突变、融合基因和核型结果，作答决策3。
guidance.en: In the work-up phase: read the marrow smear, the trephine, the gene mutation and fusion tests and the karyotype, then answer decision 3.

title.en: Agree a treatment plan with her family

hint.zh-CN: 对一个5岁的孩子，降血小板的好处和多年用药的代价怎样权衡？家属回家后要注意什么？
hint.en: For a 5-year-old, how do you weigh lowering the count against years of treatment — and what does the family need to watch for at home?

guidance.zh-CN: 作答决策4，开始选定的治疗，并向家属说明病情和注意事项。
guidance.en: Answer decision 4, start the chosen treatment, and talk the plan and the safety advice through with her family.

title.en: Respond to the new event and review the outcome

hint.zh-CN: 这个孩子出现新的神经系统症状时，最不能漏掉的是什么？
hint.en: In this child, what must you not miss when a new neurological symptom appears?

guidance.zh-CN: 治疗第2天她出现了新情况：问清经过，安排检查，作答决策5，最后调阅转归记录。
guidance.en: On treatment day 2 something new happens: find out what happened, arrange the tests, answer decision 5, then read the outcome record.

prompt.zh-CN: 5岁女孩，脐周间断疼痛10天；脐周压痛、无反跳痛，脾肋下2 cm，皮肤无出血点。两次血常规：血小板1905、1497×10⁹/L，白细胞27.29、20.27×10⁹/L；CRP<8 mg/L；入院前静脉抗感染治疗后血象没有明显变化。最可能是哪一类问题？下一步怎样查？
prompt.en: A 5-year-old girl has had periumbilical pain on and off for 10 days. She is tender around the umbilicus without rebound, her spleen is 2 cm below the costal margin and her skin shows no bleeding spots. Two counts: platelets 1905 and 1497 × 10⁹/L, white cells 27.29 and 20.27 × 10⁹/L; CRP < 8 mg/L; IV antibiotics before admission did not change the count. What kind of problem is most likely, and how will you investigate it?

need.zh-CN: 先问清腹痛和之前的治疗，摸脾，并调阅入院时的血常规和CRP。
need.en: First take the history of the pain and the earlier treatment, feel for the spleen, and read the admission blood count and CRP.

text.zh-CN: 更可能是原发（克隆性）血小板增多：抗感染后计数仍极高、CRP不高、脾可触及。查涂片和铁代谢，送BCR::ABL1和JAK2（再查CALR、MPL），做骨髓穿刺和活检
text.en: A primary (clonal) cause is likelier: an extreme count outlasting antibiotics, a CRP below 8 mg/L and a palpable spleen. Review the film and iron status, send BCR::ABL1 and JAK2 (then CALR, MPL), and plan a marrow aspirate and trephine

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。儿童血小板增多绝大多数是反应性的，但抗感染治疗后仍持续在1000×10⁹/L以上、CRP<8 mg/L、脾可触及，这一组合要求寻找原发病因（Stockklausner等，GTH/GPOH THROMKID-Plus，Ann Hematol 2021）。白细胞27.29×10⁹/L加脾大，BCR::ABL1要和JAK2同时查；之后按WHO第5版（2022）标准做骨髓穿刺和活检。
feedback.en: Right. Most raised platelet counts in children are reactive, but a count that stays above 1000 × 10⁹/L after the presumed infection is treated, with a CRP below 8 mg/L and a palpable spleen, calls for a search for a primary cause (Stockklausner et al., GTH/GPOH THROMKID-Plus, Ann Hematol 2021). With white cells of 27.29 × 10⁹/L and a spleen, BCR::ABL1 goes in alongside JAK2, then a marrow aspirate and trephine against the WHO 2022 criteria.

text.zh-CN: 仍以腹腔感染引起的反应性增多可能最大，儿童最常见的就是感染：换用更广谱的静脉抗生素再治疗一个疗程，等腹痛好转后复查血常规再决定下一步
text.en: Reactive thrombocytosis from an abdominal infection is still likeliest, as infection is the commonest cause in children: give a broader course of IV antibiotics and repeat the count once the pain has settled before deciding more

feedback.zh-CN: 感染确实是儿童血小板增多最常见的原因（Stockklausner等，GTH/GPOH，2021），但她没有发热，CRP<8 mg/L，第一个抗感染疗程后血象也没有变化。再用一个疗程治的是并不存在的感染，还会推迟对原发病因的检查。
feedback.en: Infection is the commonest cause of a raised count in children (Stockklausner et al., GTH/GPOH, 2021), but she has no fever, a CRP below 8 mg/L and a count the first course did not change. Another course treats an infection she does not have and delays the search for a primary cause.

text.zh-CN: 缺铁是儿童血小板升高最常见、也最容易纠正的原因之一：先口服铁剂，4–6周后复查血常规，计数仍不降再考虑骨髓穿刺和基因检查
text.en: Iron deficiency is among the commonest and most treatable causes of a high count in children: start oral iron, recheck the count in 4–6 weeks and consider marrow and gene tests only if it has not fallen

feedback.zh-CN: 缺铁确实会让儿童血小板升高，所以要查铁代谢——但应先测铁蛋白和血红蛋白，而不是凭经验补铁（Stockklausner等，2021）。缺铁解释不了可触及的脾脏；在1905和1497×10⁹/L的计数下等待6周，会同时推迟诊断和出血风险评估。
feedback.en: Iron deficiency does raise platelets in children, which is why iron status is checked — with a measured ferritin and haemoglobin, not an empirical trial (Stockklausner et al., 2021). It does not explain a palpable spleen, and six weeks' wait at counts of 1905 and 1497 × 10⁹/L delays both the diagnosis and the bleeding assessment.

text.zh-CN: 最可能是慢性髓系白血病：白细胞高、脾大、血小板极高都符合。立即开始伊马替尼，同时送BCR::ABL1检测加以证实，再安排骨髓穿刺
text.en: Chronic myeloid leukaemia is likeliest, with this white count, spleen and platelet count: start imatinib now, send BCR::ABL1 to confirm it and then arrange the marrow

feedback.zh-CN: 慢性髓系白血病必须排除——儿童可以表现为白细胞增高、脾大和血小板增多——但慢性髓系白血病以BCR::ABL1融合基因来定义（WHO第5版，2022），伊马替尼只能在结果阳性之后使用，不能先用后查。没有分子诊断就用药，会让孩子长期服用一种可能并不需要的药。
feedback.en: CML must be excluded — leucocytosis, a spleen and thrombocytosis are how it can present in a child — but CML is defined by the BCR::ABL1 fusion (WHO 5th edition, 2022), so imatinib follows a positive result and never precedes it. Treating before the molecular diagnosis commits a child to long-term therapy she may not need.

prompt.zh-CN: PT 14.2 s，APTT 52.3 s，纤维蛋白原1.84 g/L（实验室参考范围没有记录）；后一次血小板1497×10⁹/L。她肚脐周围疼，脾可触及。同事建议“今天就开始吃阿司匹林，预防血栓”。在任何治疗开始之前，你怎样处理出血和血栓这两方面的风险？
prompt.en: PT 14.2 s, APTT 52.3 s, fibrinogen 1.84 g/L (the laboratory's reference ranges are not recorded); the later platelet count is 1497 × 10⁹/L. Her pain is around the umbilicus and her spleen is palpable. A colleague suggests starting aspirin today “to prevent a clot”. Before any treatment starts, how do you deal with the bleeding and the clotting risks?

need.zh-CN: 先作出初步判断，并调阅凝血功能结果。
need.en: Make your first assessment and read the clotting screen first.

text.zh-CN: 暂不用阿司匹林：查VWF抗原、VWF活性和Ⅷ因子，对照实验室范围复核APTT，并做门静脉、脾静脉和肠系膜静脉的多普勒超声
text.en: No aspirin yet: send VWF antigen, VWF activity and factor VIII, recheck the APTT against the lab's range, and arrange a Doppler ultrasound of the portal, splenic and mesenteric veins

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。血小板超过约1000×10⁹/L时，大分子VWF多聚体会被血小板吸附并降解（获得性血管性血友病综合征），阿司匹林可能把血栓风险变成出血风险；所以先测VWF活性，活性低时先降血小板（Tiede等，How I treat AVWS，Blood 2011）。脐周痛加脾大还要排除内脏静脉血栓，儿童首选多普勒超声；VWF结果也决定骨髓活检时的止血准备。
feedback.en: Right. Above about 1000 × 10⁹/L, platelets bind and help degrade the largest VWF multimers (acquired von Willebrand syndrome), so aspirin can turn a clotting risk into a bleeding one: VWF activity is measured first, and a low activity means lowering the count before any antiplatelet drug (Tiede et al., How I treat AVWS, Blood 2011). Periumbilical pain with a spleen also raises splanchnic vein thrombosis, for which Doppler ultrasound is the first test in a child, and the VWF result guides bleeding precautions for the marrow biopsy.

text.zh-CN: 今天就开始小剂量阿司匹林：这么高的血小板最大的危险是血栓，出血方面的检查可以在用药期间再补做；同时请儿童血液科会诊，共同决定是否还要降细胞治疗
text.en: Start low-dose aspirin today: at this count thrombosis is the main danger and the bleeding tests can follow while she takes it; ask paediatric haematology to see her and decide together on cytoreduction

feedback.zh-CN: 这正是同事的建议，阿司匹林也在报告用过的药物之中——但开始的时间没有记录。血小板这么高、APTT 52.3 s尚未解释、VWF活性未知时，阿司匹林可能引起严重出血（Tiede等，2011）；而且16岁以下儿童只有在有明确指征时才用阿司匹林（英国MHRA，2003），因为有瑞氏综合征的风险。
feedback.en: It is the colleague's suggestion, and aspirin was among the report's drugs — though when it started is not recorded. With a count this high, an unexplained APTT of 52.3 s and VWF activity unknown, aspirin can cause serious bleeding (Tiede et al., 2011); and in a child under 16, aspirin is used only for a specific indication (UK MHRA, 2003), because of Reye's syndrome.

text.zh-CN: 开始预防剂量的低分子肝素：疼了10天、血小板又这么高，很可能已经有肠系膜静脉血栓，在做影像检查之前就先抗凝，之后再根据超声结果调整剂量
text.en: Start prophylactic low-molecular-weight heparin: ten days of pain at this count suggests a mesenteric vein clot, so anticoagulate before any imaging and adjust the dose once the ultrasound is back

feedback.zh-CN: 内脏静脉血栓需要考虑，但要先用影像证实；APTT 52.3 s没有解释、VWF活性未知时盲目抗凝会增加出血风险。腹部多普勒超声是儿童的首选检查，证实血栓后再与儿童血液科一起制定抗凝方案（Tefferi等，Am J Hematol 2024）。
feedback.en: Splanchnic vein thrombosis needs considering, but it is shown on imaging first: blind anticoagulation with an unexplained APTT of 52.3 s and VWF activity unknown adds bleeding risk. Doppler ultrasound is the first test in a child, and anticoagulation is planned with paediatric haematology once a clot is shown (Tefferi, Vannucchi and Barbui, Am J Hematol 2024).

text.zh-CN: 今天做腹部增强CT，看有没有阑尾炎或者肠系膜静脉血栓；如果CT正常，就开始小剂量阿司匹林，预防以后形成血栓，凝血结果暂时不必处理
text.en: Request a contrast CT of the abdomen today for appendicitis or a mesenteric clot; if it is clear, start low-dose aspirin to prevent future clots and leave the clotting results for now

feedback.zh-CN: 担心血栓是对的，但儿童首选多普勒超声，没有辐射，可以床旁做，必要时再做CT。更关键的是，CT正常并不能解决出血问题：血小板这么高时，VWF活性明确之前不宜开始阿司匹林，APTT 52.3 s也需要解释（Tiede等，2011）。
feedback.en: The worry about a clot is right, but Doppler ultrasound comes first in a child — no radiation, at the bedside — with CT if it is inconclusive. And a clear scan does not settle the bleeding question: at this count aspirin waits until VWF activity is known, and an APTT of 52.3 s needs explaining (Tiede et al., 2011).

prompt.zh-CN: 骨髓涂片：巨核细胞172个，其中产板型100个；骨髓活检：骨髓增生性改变，网状纤维“±”。JAK2 V617F（G/T杂合）阳性；BCR::ABL1 P210和另一项融合基因阴性；核型46,XX。这些结果说明了什么？还缺什么？
prompt.en: Marrow smear: 172 megakaryocytes, 100 platelet-producing. Trephine: myeloproliferative changes, reticulin “±”. JAK2 V617F (heterozygous G/T) detected; BCR::ABL1 P210 and a second fusion test negative; karyotype 46,XX. What do these establish, and what is still missing?

need.zh-CN: 先调阅骨髓涂片、骨髓活检、基因突变、融合基因和核型结果。
need.en: First read the marrow smear, the trephine, the gene mutation and fusion tests and the karyotype.

text.zh-CN: BCR::ABL1阴性、JAK2 V617F阳性的骨髓增殖性肿瘤，多为原发性血小板增多症；按WHO 2022还需查血红蛋白并复核骨髓形态，排除纤维化前期骨髓纤维化
text.en: A BCR::ABL1-negative, JAK2 V617F-positive myeloproliferative neoplasm, essential thrombocythaemia likely; WHO 2022 still needs her haemoglobin and a marrow morphology review against prefibrotic myelofibrosis

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。原发性血小板增多症要求：血小板≥450×10⁹/L；骨髓以体积大、成熟、核分叶多的巨核细胞增生为主；不符合BCR::ABL1阳性慢性髓系白血病、真性红细胞增多症、原发性骨髓纤维化等其他髓系肿瘤的标准；有JAK2、CALR或MPL突变（WHO第5版，2022，沿用此前标准）。她的血红蛋白没有记录，骨髓描述也缺巨核细胞形态和增生程度，而白细胞≥11×10⁹/L和可触及的脾脏正是纤维化前期骨髓纤维化的次要标准——所以诊断要靠骨髓复核。
feedback.en: Right. Essential thrombocythaemia needs platelets ≥ 450 × 10⁹/L, a marrow dominated by large, mature megakaryocytes with hyperlobulated nuclei, exclusion of BCR::ABL1-positive CML, polycythaemia vera, primary myelofibrosis and other myeloid neoplasms, and a JAK2, CALR or MPL mutation (WHO 5th edition, 2022, keeping the earlier criteria). Her haemoglobin is not recorded and the marrow report lacks megakaryocyte morphology and cellularity, while white cells ≥ 11 × 10⁹/L and a palpable spleen are minor criteria for prefibrotic myelofibrosis — so the label rests on a marrow review.

text.zh-CN: 仍应按慢性髓系白血病处理：白细胞高、脾大、巨核细胞增生都符合，PCR可能漏掉了少见的融合转录本，所以先开始伊马替尼，以后再复查融合基因，必要时重复骨髓检查和染色体分析
text.en: Still treat it as chronic myeloid leukaemia: the white count, the spleen and the megakaryocytic hyperplasia all fit, and the PCR may have missed a rare transcript, so start imatinib now and repeat the fusion testing later

feedback.zh-CN: BCR::ABL1 P210和另一项融合基因均阴性，核型46,XX没有费城染色体，又检出JAK2 V617F，慢性髓系白血病没有依据；慢性髓系白血病以BCR::ABL1来定义（WHO第5版，2022），对少见转录本的疑问应通过进一步检测（如FISH）解决，而不是先用伊马替尼。
feedback.en: BCR::ABL1 P210 and a second fusion test are negative, the 46,XX karyotype shows no Philadelphia chromosome and a JAK2 V617F mutation is present: there is no case for CML. Because CML is defined by BCR::ABL1 (WHO 5th edition, 2022), a doubt about a rare transcript is settled by further testing such as FISH, not by starting imatinib.

text.zh-CN: 这是纤维化前期原发性骨髓纤维化，不是原发性血小板增多症：白细胞增高、脾大，活检又见网状纤维，诊断已经可以确定，报告的诊断是错的
text.en: This is prefibrotic primary myelofibrosis, not essential thrombocythaemia: leucocytosis, a palpable spleen and reticulin on the trephine settle it, so the report's diagnosis is wrong

feedback.zh-CN: 白细胞≥11×10⁹/L和可触及的脾脏确实是纤维化前期骨髓纤维化的次要标准，但它的主要标准要求巨核细胞增生伴异型、增生程度增高和粒系增生——这些形态学描述本病例没有记录；网状纤维“±”两种诊断都可以见到（WHO第5版，2022）。这是需要骨髓复核的问题，不是已经定论的答案。
feedback.en: White cells ≥ 11 × 10⁹/L and a palpable spleen are indeed minor criteria for prefibrotic myelofibrosis, but its major criteria need atypical megakaryocytic proliferation with increased cellularity and granulocytic proliferation — morphology this case does not record — and reticulin “±” fits either diagnosis (WHO 5th edition, 2022). It is a question for the marrow review, not a settled answer.

text.zh-CN: 这么小就发病，更像遗传性血小板增多症：先查父母血常规和胚系基因，暂停其余的骨髓评估，JAK2结果先不作解释
text.en: Onset this young points to hereditary thrombocytosis: check the parents' counts and germline genes first, pause the marrow assessment and leave the JAK2 result aside for now

feedback.zh-CN: 遗传性血小板增多症（如THPO、MPL的胚系变异）确实是儿童鉴别诊断的一部分，查父母血常规也合理（Stockklausner等，2021）。但JAK2 V617F几乎都是获得性的驱动突变，骨髓活检又示骨髓增生性改变，这个结果不能放在一边；评估应继续，而不是暂停。
feedback.en: Hereditary thrombocytosis (germline THPO or MPL variants, for example) is part of the paediatric differential, and checking the parents' counts is reasonable (Stockklausner et al., 2021). But JAK2 V617F is almost always an acquired driver mutation and the trephine shows myeloproliferative changes: the result cannot be set aside, and the assessment goes on rather than pausing.

prompt.zh-CN: 她5岁，JAK2 V617F阳性，两次血小板1905和1497×10⁹/L，有腹痛，脾可触及，没有VWF结果。和儿童血液科一起，怎样开始治疗？
prompt.en: She is 5 years old and JAK2 V617F-positive, with platelet counts of 1905 and 1497 × 10⁹/L, abdominal pain and a palpable spleen; there is no VWF result. With paediatric haematology, how do you start treatment?

need.zh-CN: 先完成对骨髓和基因结果的判读。
need.en: Interpret the marrow and genetic results first.

text.zh-CN: 与儿童血液科一起选一种一线降细胞药（羟基脲或聚乙二醇干扰素α）；阿司匹林等VWF活性证实足够后再定；书面交代布洛芬、水痘和流感的注意事项
text.en: One first-line cytoreductive drug, hydroxyurea or pegylated interferon-α, chosen with paediatric haematology; aspirin only once VWF activity is shown to be adequate; written advice on ibuprofen, chickenpox and flu

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。儿童没有共识指南，只能外推成人证据：降细胞治疗用于高危疾病，一线药物为羟基脲或干扰素α（ELN 2018；Tefferi等，Am J Hematol 2024）。干扰素可免去几十年接触羟基脲，但每周注射以及流感样和情绪方面的不良反应对5岁孩子并不容易，而羟基脲在儿童镰状细胞病中已有长期使用经验（Stockklausner等，2021）——所以由儿童血液科和家属一起选药。计数持续极高是儿童专家提出降细胞治疗的理由之一；阿司匹林要等VWF活性证实足够；由于瑞氏综合征，用阿司匹林的孩子出水痘或流感时要停药就诊（英国MHRA，2003）。
feedback.en: Right. With no paediatric consensus, adult evidence is extrapolated: cytoreduction is for high-risk disease, with hydroxyurea or interferon-α first line (ELN 2018; Tefferi, Vannucchi and Barbui, Am J Hematol 2024). Interferon spares a child decades of hydroxyurea, but weekly injections and flu-like and mood effects are hard at 5, while hydroxyurea has long paediatric use in sickle cell disease (Stockklausner et al., 2021) — so the drug is chosen with paediatric haematology and the family. A count that stays extreme is one reason paediatric experts give for cytoreduction; aspirin waits until VWF activity is shown to be adequate, and because of Reye's syndrome a child taking aspirin stops it and is seen during chickenpox or flu (UK MHRA, 2003).

text.zh-CN: 把报告用过的三种药——羟基脲、干扰素和阿司匹林——同时开始，尽快把血小板降到正常范围，之后根据血常规一种一种地减药，阿司匹林则一直长期服用
text.en: Start the three drugs the report used — hydroxyurea, interferon and aspirin — at the same time to bring the count to normal fast, then taper the two cytoreductive drugs one by one as the count falls and keep the aspirin long term

feedback.zh-CN: 报告确实用了这三种药（还有“等”所指的其他药），但剂量、开始日期和先后顺序没有记录。两种降细胞药同时起用会叠加骨髓抑制和不良反应，没有证据显示获益更大——成人指南都是选一种一线药（Tefferi等，2024）；阿司匹林在VWF活性明确之前也不宜开始。
feedback.en: The report did use all three, among others, but their doses, start days and order are not recorded. Two cytoreductive drugs from the start add marrow suppression and side effects with no evidence of greater benefit — adult guidance starts one first-line drug (Tefferi et al., 2024) — and aspirin should not start before VWF activity is known.

text.zh-CN: 她年轻、没有血栓史，按成人修订版IPSET评分属于低危：只用小剂量阿司匹林并观察，暂时不需要降细胞治疗
text.en: She is young with no thrombosis, so the adult revised IPSET score makes her low risk: low-dose aspirin alone with observation, and no cytoreduction for now

feedback.zh-CN: 修订版IPSET是成人模型，没有在儿童中验证；成人的BSH 2010方案则把血小板>1500×10⁹/L本身列为高危。更重要的是，血小板这么高、VWF活性未知时，单用阿司匹林恰恰增加了要避免的出血风险（Tiede等，2011）。
feedback.en: The revised IPSET is an adult model, not validated in children, and the adult BSH 2010 scheme counts a platelet count above 1500 × 10⁹/L as high risk in itself. Above all, aspirin alone at this count with VWF activity unknown adds exactly the bleeding risk to avoid (Tiede et al., 2011).

text.zh-CN: 为避免孩子长期用羟基脲，首选阿那格雷降血小板，同时加小剂量阿司匹林预防血栓，两周后复查血常规
text.en: To spare a child years of hydroxyurea, use anagrelide first to lower the platelets, with low-dose aspirin against clots and a repeat count in two weeks

feedback.zh-CN: 阿那格雷不在当前成人综述的一线药物之列（Tefferi等，2024）：PT-1试验（809例高危患者，NEJM 2005）中，阿那格雷加阿司匹林比羟基脲加阿司匹林有更多动脉血栓、严重出血和向骨髓纤维化转化。想避免羟基脲，合理的选择是干扰素α，而阿司匹林仍要等VWF活性明确。
feedback.en: Anagrelide is not among the first-line drugs in current adult reviews (Tefferi et al., 2024): in PT-1 (809 high-risk patients, NEJM 2005), anagrelide plus aspirin led to more arterial thrombosis, serious haemorrhage and transformation to myelofibrosis than hydroxyurea plus aspirin. The way to spare hydroxyurea is interferon-α, and aspirin still waits for VWF activity.

prompt.zh-CN: 治疗第2天，她发生了一次短暂的无热惊厥（当时已经用了哪些药没有记录）。现在首先怎么处理？
prompt.en: On treatment day 2 she has a brief seizure without fever (which drugs she had received by then is not recorded). What do you do first?

text.zh-CN: 在影像排除之前按可能的卒中或静脉窦血栓处理：查气道和床旁血糖，复查血象和凝血，暂停抗血小板药，急查含弥散、静脉和动脉成像的MRI，请神经科会诊
text.en: Treat it as a possible stroke or sinus thrombosis until imaging says otherwise: airway, bedside glucose, count and clotting, antiplatelet drugs held, an urgent MRI with diffusion, venous and arterial sequences, and neurology

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。骨髓增殖性肿瘤、血小板极高的孩子新出现惊厥，在影像证明之前要当作动脉缺血性卒中、静脉窦血栓或颅内出血；英国RCPCH儿童卒中指南（2017）要求疑似卒中在到院1小时内完成脑影像，诊断不明时做MRI。排除出血之前暂停抗血小板药，同时查血糖、血象和凝血，覆盖可以治疗的原因。
feedback.en: Right. In a child with a myeloproliferative neoplasm and an extreme count, a new seizure is an arterial stroke, a venous sinus thrombosis or a bleed until imaging shows otherwise; the RCPCH childhood stroke guideline (2017) asks for brain imaging within 1 hour of arrival for a suspected stroke, with MRI when the diagnosis is uncertain. Antiplatelet drugs are held until a bleed is excluded, and glucose, the count and clotting cover the treatable causes.

text.zh-CN: 一次短暂、已经停止、不发热的惊厥，孩子其他方面也还好，可以按通常的首次无热惊厥路径处理：门诊做脑电图，两周内到儿童神经科门诊复诊，暂时不需要急查影像
text.en: A single brief seizure without fever that has stopped, in a child who is otherwise doing well, can follow the usual first-seizure pathway: an outpatient EEG and a paediatric neurology clinic appointment within two weeks, with no urgent scan

feedback.zh-CN: 首次无热惊厥的门诊路径是为原本健康的孩子设计的；她有骨髓增殖性肿瘤、血小板极高、刚开始新药，惊厥可能是血管事件的首发表现，需要当天急查影像（RCPCH 2017）。
feedback.en: The outpatient first-seizure pathway is for otherwise healthy children; she has a myeloproliferative neoplasm, an extreme count and new drugs, and a seizure may be the first sign of a vascular event that needs same-day imaging (RCPCH 2017).

text.zh-CN: 立即静脉给左乙拉西坦负荷量，防止再次发作；等她情况稳定以后，这几天里再安排头颅MRI，必要时加做脑电图
text.en: Give a loading dose of IV levetiracetam now to prevent another seizure, and book a brain MRI and, if needed, an EEG for when she is settled over the next few days

feedback.zh-CN: 一次短暂、已经停止的惊厥，在原因不明之前不需要立即用抗癫痫药；真正紧急的是找原因——血糖、血象、凝血和当天的脑影像（RCPCH 2017）。把MRI推迟几天，可能错过需要处理的血栓或出血。
feedback.en: One brief seizure that has stopped does not call for an antiseizure drug before its cause is known; what is urgent is finding the cause — glucose, the count, clotting and same-day brain imaging (RCPCH 2017). Putting the MRI off for days can miss a clot or bleed that needs treatment.

text.zh-CN: 多半是新用的药物引起的（干扰素可引起神经系统不良反应）：先停用干扰素，观察一夜，如果再次发作才做影像检查
text.en: It is most likely the new drug, since interferon can cause neurological side effects: stop the interferon, watch her overnight, and scan only if she has another seizure

feedback.zh-CN: 干扰素确实有神经精神方面的不良反应，药物原因可以在排除血管原因之后再考虑；但本病例没有记录她当时用了哪些药，不做影像就归因于药物，可能漏掉卒中、静脉窦血栓或出血（RCPCH 2017）。
feedback.en: Interferon does have neuropsychiatric side effects, and a drug cause can be weighed once vascular causes are excluded; but the case does not record which drugs she was on, and blaming a drug without imaging risks missing a stroke, venous sinus thrombosis or bleed (RCPCH 2017).

text.zh-CN: 问清腹痛的部位、规律和诱因，以及发热流涕、出血、消化道症状和抗感染治疗后的变化
text.en: Asked where the pain is, how it comes and goes and what sets it off, and about fever and a runny nose, bleeding, bowel symptoms and the change after antibiotics

text.zh-CN: 追问既往健康和生长发育、住院手术及用药、过敏和疫苗、家族遗传病和家人血象，以及头痛和视物症状
text.en: Asked about past health and growth, earlier admissions and medicines, allergies and vaccinations, inherited illness and blood counts in the family, and headaches or visual symptoms

text.zh-CN: 查看一般情况和皮肤黏膜出血，触诊腹部、检查反跳痛，并触诊脾脏
text.en: Looked at her general condition and for bleeding in the skin and mucosa, palpated the abdomen, checked for rebound and felt for the spleen

text.zh-CN: 入院时调阅两次血常规、CRP和凝血并送铁代谢；住院检查阶段调阅骨髓涂片、活检、基因突变、融合基因和核型
text.en: Read both counts, the CRP and the clotting screen and sent iron studies on admission; read the marrow smear and trephine, the gene mutation and fusion tests and the karyotype in the work-up

text.zh-CN: 首次作答即判断应寻找原发病因并规划相应检查，没有再加抗生素
text.en: Judged at the first attempt that a primary cause must be sought, planned its work-up, and gave no further antibiotics

text.zh-CN: 首次作答即先评估出血和血栓：入院时送VWF检测和腹部多普勒超声，并在医嘱单上注明暂停抗血小板药
text.en: Weighed bleeding and clotting first at the first attempt: VWF tests and an abdominal Doppler ultrasound sent on admission, and the chart marked no antiplatelet drugs for now

text.zh-CN: 在出血风险明确之前没有用阿司匹林，也没有不经影像就用肝素抗凝
text.en: Gave no aspirin before the bleeding risk was known, and no heparin without a clot shown on imaging

text.zh-CN: 首次作答即确认骨髓增殖性肿瘤，并指出血红蛋白和骨髓形态复核仍不可少
text.en: Recognised a myeloproliferative neoplasm at the first attempt and named the haemoglobin and marrow morphology review still needed

text.zh-CN: 首次作答即选择单一一线降细胞药，开始治疗而不叠加第二种，并向家属说明病情和用药安全
text.en: Chose a single first-line cytoreductive drug at the first attempt, started it without adding a second, and talked the diagnosis and drug safety through with the family

text.zh-CN: 惊厥当天就安排了急诊脑影像
text.en: Arranged urgent brain imaging on the day of the seizure

text.zh-CN: 首次作答即按可能的血管事件处理惊厥：查血糖和电解质、请神经科，不急于用抗癫痫药，也不做腰穿
text.en: Treated the seizure as a possible vascular event at the first attempt: glucose and electrolytes, a neurology review, no rushed antiseizure drug and no lumbar puncture

text.zh-CN: 用家属和孩子听得懂的话说明一种需要长期随访的血液病，并确认理解
text.en: Explained a long-term blood disorder in words the family and the child understand, and checked their understanding

judgeGuidance.zh-CN: 良好表现（Calgary–Cambridge）：介绍自己，确认在场的是谁、想知道多少；先问家属已经知道什么、最担心什么（家属担心“血液里有什么大毛病”、要不要一直吃药）；分段说明并随时确认：“她的骨髓做出的血小板太多了，这是一种需要长期随访、可以用药控制的血液病”；解释为什么暂时不用阿司匹林（先查出血风险）、准备用什么药降血小板、可能的不良反应；具体交代需要马上回来的情况（出血、剧烈头痛、抽搐、腹痛加重），以及不自行用阿司匹林或布洛芬、出水痘或流感时的处理、疫苗；用孩子能懂的话告诉清和要打针吃药、会经常抽血；请家属复述关键点，给书面材料，约好复诊。惊厥之后：如实说明正在查原因、MRI的意义和局限。不要引用成人的统计数字来预测她的结局，不要承诺“治好”，不要指责之前的抗生素治疗，不要用术语堆砌。
judgeGuidance.en: Good performance (Calgary–Cambridge): introduces themself, checks who is present and how much they want to know; asks first what the family already knows and what worries them most (“something badly wrong with her blood”, lifelong medicine); explains in chunks and checks as they go — “her bone marrow makes too many platelets; it is a long-term blood condition that medicines can control, with regular check-ups”; explains why aspirin is held for now (the bleeding risk is checked first), which drug will lower the count and its side effects; gives specific reasons to come straight back (bleeding, a severe headache, a fit, worse tummy pain), no aspirin or ibuprofen unless prescribed, what to do in chickenpox or flu, and vaccinations; tells Qinghe in words a 5-year-old understands about the injections, tablets and blood tests; checks understanding by teach-back, gives written information and books follow-up. After the seizure: says honestly that the cause is being looked for, and what the MRI can and cannot show. Does not quote adult statistics as her outlook, promise a cure, blame the earlier antibiotics or bury the family in jargon.

knowledge.zh-CN: 儿科上级医师，用苏格拉底式提问带教，按PEARLS复盘，只围绕学员已经得到的资料提问，例如：“孩子血小板高，最常见的原因是什么？什么情况下你会怀疑不是反应性的？”“在开任何抗血小板药之前，你最担心什么？”“JAK2阳性能说明什么、不能说明什么？诊断还缺哪块证据？”“对一个5岁的孩子，降血小板治疗的好处和代价怎么权衡？”“她出现无热惊厥时，你首先要排除什么？”复盘时（转归记录开放之后）复盘时（转归记录开放之后）说明这是2013年发表的历史病例：报告用了羟基脲、干扰素和阿司匹林等，诊断标准和对出血风险的认识与现在不同，单个病例不能评价疗效；儿童没有共识指南，成人证据只能谨慎外推。不提前透露诊断、决策答案或结局；生命体征、体重、血红蛋白和血涂片、VWF、铁代谢、腹部影像、各药剂量和开始时间、惊厥细节和MRI序列都没有记录，不要替它补上。
knowledge.en: Paediatric attending who teaches by Socratic questions and debriefs with PEARLS, asking only about what the learner already has, e.g. “What usually raises a child's platelet count, and when would you suspect it is not reactive?”, “Before you prescribe any antiplatelet drug, what worries you most?”, “What does a positive JAK2 tell you, what does it not, and which piece of evidence is still missing?”, “For a 5-year-old, how do you weigh the benefit of lowering the count against its costs?”, “When she has a seizure without fever, what do you rule out first?”. At the debrief, once the outcome record is open, explains that this is a historical case published in 2013: the report gave hydroxyurea, interferon and aspirin among others, its diagnostic criteria and its view of bleeding risk differ from today's, and a single case cannot judge treatment; there is no paediatric consensus, so adult evidence is extrapolated with care. Never reveals the diagnosis, a decision's answer or the outcome early; vital signs, weight, haemoglobin and the film, VWF, iron studies, abdominal imaging, the drugs' doses and start days, the seizure's details and the MRI sequences are not recorded — never supply them.

knowledge.zh-CN: 儿科病房护士。交班（ISBAR）：5岁女孩，由家属陪同收入病房；脐周间断疼痛10天，无明显诱因；这10天里化验发现血小板很高，记录到的一次是1905×10⁹/L；入院前静脉用过抗感染药，腹痛稍减轻，血常规没有明显变化；她神志清楚，一般情况好。她手头的记录里没有生命体征和体重，被问到就直说没有记录。可以协助建立静脉通路和采血、送检标本、联系超声和磁共振、在医嘱单上加注、联系血液科和神经科，惊厥时协助保持气道和侧卧。复述医嘱，只报告已经出来的结果，不解读、不诊断。
knowledge.en: Children's ward nurse. Handover (ISBAR): 5-year-old girl admitted with a relative; ten days of intermittent periumbilical pain with no obvious trigger; a very high platelet count found over those ten days, one recorded count 1905 × 10⁹/L; IV antibiotics before admission eased the pain a little without changing the blood count; she is alert and generally well. Her vital signs and weight are not in the notes she has, and she says so if asked. Can help with IV access and bloods, sending samples, booking the ultrasound and the MRI, chart alerts, calling haematology and neurology, and the airway and recovery position during a seizure. Reads orders back, reports only results that are back, never interprets or diagnoses.

name.zh-CN: 顾医生（儿童血液科会诊）

knowledge.zh-CN: 儿童血液科会诊医生，只解读学员已经看过的结果。可以讲：儿童血小板增多以反应性为主，原发性少见，分子特点与成人不同，遗传性血小板增多（THPO、MPL胚系变异）也要考虑（Stockklausner等，2021）；WHO第5版（2022）原发性血小板增多症与纤维化前期骨髓纤维化的标准，以及为什么需要血红蛋白和骨髓形态复核；血小板超过约1000×10⁹/L时的获得性血管性血友病综合征，VWF抗原、活性和Ⅷ因子的意义（Tiede等，2011）；降细胞治疗的选择——羟基脲或聚乙二醇干扰素α为一线，阿那格雷在PT-1中不如羟基脲（Tefferi等，2024；Harrison等，2005），成人风险评分不能直接用于儿童。不提前给出决策答案或结局，不补充没有记录的结果。
knowledge.en: Paediatric haematology consultant who interprets only results the learner has already read. Can explain that raised counts in children are mostly reactive, primary forms are rare, the molecular picture differs from adults', and hereditary thrombocytosis (germline THPO or MPL variants) is part of the differential (Stockklausner et al., 2021); the WHO 5th edition (2022) criteria for essential thrombocythaemia and prefibrotic myelofibrosis, and why the haemoglobin and a marrow morphology review are needed; acquired von Willebrand syndrome above about 1000 × 10⁹/L and what VWF antigen, activity and factor VIII show (Tiede et al., 2011); the cytoreductive choices — hydroxyurea or pegylated interferon-α first line, anagrelide inferior to hydroxyurea in PT-1 (Tefferi et al., 2024; Harrison et al., 2005) — and why adult risk scores do not transfer to children. Never gives a decision's answer or the outcome early, and adds no result the case does not record.

name.zh-CN: 方医生（儿童神经科会诊）

knowledge.zh-CN: 儿童神经科会诊医生，在惊厥阶段会诊，只解读学员已经看过的结果。可以讲：有血栓或出血倾向的孩子新出现惊厥，先按可能的动脉缺血性卒中、静脉窦血栓或出血处理；RCPCH儿童卒中指南（2017）要求疑似卒中在到院1小时内完成脑影像，诊断不明时做MRI，怀疑静脉窦血栓时要有静脉成像；同时查血糖和电解质；一次短暂、已经停止的惊厥在原因查清前不急于用抗癫痫药；腰穿不是首要检查。增强MRI“未见异常”能排除什么、在序列没有记录时不能排除什么。不提前给出决策答案或结局，不补充没有记录的结果。
knowledge.en: Paediatric neurology consultant who reviews her in the seizure phase and interprets only results the learner has already read. Can explain that a new seizure in a child prone to clots or bleeding is treated as a possible arterial ischaemic stroke, venous sinus thrombosis or bleed first; that the RCPCH childhood stroke guideline (2017) asks for brain imaging within 1 hour of arrival for a suspected stroke, MRI when the diagnosis is uncertain, and venous imaging when sinus thrombosis is possible; glucose and electrolytes alongside; no rush to an antiseizure drug after one brief seizure that has stopped before its cause is known; and why a lumbar puncture is not the first test. Explains what a contrast MRI reported as showing no abnormality does exclude, and what it cannot when the sequences are not recorded. Never gives a decision's answer or the outcome early, and adds no result the case does not record.

title.zh-CN: 复盘：学龄前儿童JAK2 V617F阳性的原发性血小板增多症
title.en: Debrief: JAK2 V617F-positive essential thrombocythaemia in a 5-year-old

conclusion.zh-CN: 5岁女孩脐周间断疼痛10天、无明显诱因，同期发现血小板很高；入院前静脉抗感染后腹痛稍减，血象无明显变化。无发热、流涕、黏膜出血和消化道症状；神志清楚，一般情况好，脐周压痛、无反跳痛，无出血点，脾肋下2 cm。血小板1905后1497×10⁹/L，白细胞27.29后20.27×10⁹/L，CRP<8 mg/L；PT 14.2 s，APTT 52.3 s，纤维蛋白原1.84 g/L。骨髓巨核细胞172个（产板型100个），活检示骨髓增生性改变、网状纤维“±”；JAK2 V617F杂合，BCR::ABL1 P210阴性，核型46,XX。报告诊断儿童原发性血小板增多症，给予羟基脲、干扰素和阿司匹林等；治疗第2天短暂无热惊厥，增强MRI未见异常；第15天血小板559×10⁹/L，随访5个月220–390×10⁹/L，未再腹痛。现在的做法：按WHO 2022标准补齐血红蛋白和骨髓形态复核；用药前先查VWF活性和腹部静脉；与儿童血液科选一种降细胞药；新的惊厥当天做脑影像。
conclusion.en: A 5-year-old girl had 10 days of intermittent periumbilical pain with no trigger and a very high platelet count; IV antibiotics eased the pain a little, not the count. No fever, runny nose, mucosal bleeding or bowel symptoms; alert and generally well, periumbilical tenderness without rebound, no petechiae, spleen 2 cm below the costal margin. Platelets 1905 then 1497 × 10⁹/L, white cells 27.29 then 20.27 × 10⁹/L, CRP < 8 mg/L; PT 14.2 s, APTT 52.3 s, fibrinogen 1.84 g/L. Marrow: 172 megakaryocytes (100 platelet-producing), myeloproliferative changes, reticulin “±”; JAK2 V617F heterozygous, BCR::ABL1 P210 negative, 46,XX. The report diagnosed childhood essential thrombocythaemia and gave hydroxyurea, interferon and aspirin, among others; after a brief afebrile seizure on treatment day 2 a contrast MRI showed no abnormality; platelets were 559 × 10⁹/L by day 15 and 220–390 × 10⁹/L over 5 months, with no further abdominal pain. Today: complete the WHO 2022 criteria, check VWF and the abdominal veins before aspirin, use one cytoreductive drug, image a new seizure that day.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 线索在计数而不在腹痛：没有发热、CRP<8 mg/L、抗感染后计数不变，感染解释不了；可触及的脾脏和27.29×10⁹/L的白细胞把方向指向骨髓。
keyReasoning.en: The lead is the count, not the pain: no fever, a CRP below 8 mg/L and a count unchanged by antibiotics argue against infection, and a palpable spleen with white cells of 27.29 × 10⁹/L point to the marrow.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 处理血栓风险之前先量化出血风险：APTT 52.3 s加1905和1497×10⁹/L的计数，提示可能有获得性血管性血友病综合征——阿司匹林要等VWF活性，腹部静脉要先看影像，而不是盲目抗凝。
keyReasoning.en: Measure the bleeding risk before treating the clotting risk: an APTT of 52.3 s and counts of 1905 and 1497 × 10⁹/L make acquired von Willebrand syndrome possible, so aspirin waits for VWF activity and the abdominal veins are imaged rather than anticoagulated blind.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: JAK2 V617F证明是克隆性骨髓增殖性肿瘤，但没说明是哪一种：BCR::ABL1阴性排除了慢性髓系白血病，原发性血小板增多症与纤维化前期骨髓纤维化的区分仍要靠血红蛋白和骨髓形态。
keyReasoning.en: A JAK2 V617F result proves a clonal myeloproliferative neoplasm, not which one: BCR::ABL1 negativity excludes CML, but telling essential thrombocythaemia from prefibrotic myelofibrosis still needs the haemoglobin and the marrow morphology.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 成人风险评分不能照搬：治疗决策要同时考虑症状、极高计数带来的出血风险，以及一个5岁孩子要接受多年药物。
keyReasoning.en: Adult risk scores do not transfer: the treatment decision weighs symptoms, the bleeding risk of an extreme count and years of drug exposure for a 5-year-old.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 骨髓增殖性肿瘤的孩子出现新的神经系统事件，在影像证明之前都按血管事件处理；事后知道报告的增强MRI未见异常，不能成为不做影像检查的理由。
keyReasoning.en: A new neurological event in a child with a myeloproliferative neoplasm is vascular until imaging shows otherwise; knowing that the report's contrast MRI showed no abnormality is hindsight, not a reason to skip the scan.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 报告的好结局（第15天559×10⁹/L，5个月220–390×10⁹/L，未再腹痛）出现在用了羟基脲、干扰素和阿司匹林等药物之后，而这些药的剂量和先后顺序都没有记录：它不能说明哪种药起了作用，也说明不了惊厥的原因。
keyReasoning.en: The report's good course (559 × 10⁹/L by day 15, 220–390 × 10⁹/L over 5 months, no further abdominal pain) followed hydroxyurea, interferon and aspirin, among others, whose doses and order are not recorded: it cannot show which drug helped, nor what caused the seizure.

boundaries.zh-CN: 这是2013年发表的单例报告，不能用来比较治疗，也不能据此判断儿童原发性血小板增多症的预后。病例事实沿用1.0.0版的提取内容，尚未对照原文全文核对；报告没有记录生命体征、血红蛋白、VWF检测、腹部影像、各药剂量和惊厥的细节，病例也不模拟任何生理变化。儿童没有共识指南，决策、处置选项、评分和教学要点是依据成人指南谨慎外推的教学设计，不改变已发表的病程。
boundaries.en: This is a single case report published in 2013: it cannot compare treatments or set a prognosis for childhood essential thrombocythaemia. The case facts are those extracted for version 1.0.0 and have not yet been checked against the full article; no vital signs, haemoglobin, VWF tests, abdominal imaging, drug doses or seizure details are recorded, and no physiology is simulated. There is no paediatric consensus guideline, so the decisions, management options, scoring and teaching points are teaching design that extrapolates adult guidance with care; they do not change the published course.

unknowns.zh-CN: 生命体征、体重和身高；肝脏大小和浅表淋巴结；任何时间的神经系统查体。
unknowns.en: Her vital signs, weight and height; liver size and lymph nodes; a neurological examination at any point.

unknowns.zh-CN: 血红蛋白、平均红细胞体积、白细胞分类和血涂片；两次血常规和CRP的日期；血沉。
unknowns.en: Haemoglobin, MCV, the white-cell differential and the blood film; the dates of the two counts and of the CRP; any ESR.

unknowns.zh-CN: PT、APTT和纤维蛋白原的实验室参考范围；VWF抗原、VWF活性和Ⅷ因子；铁代谢、乳酸脱氢酶和尿酸。
unknowns.en: The laboratory's reference ranges for PT, APTT and fibrinogen; VWF antigen, VWF activity and factor VIII; iron studies, LDH and urate.

unknowns.zh-CN: 腹部影像（超声或门静脉、脾静脉、肠系膜静脉多普勒）以及腹痛的原因。
unknowns.en: Abdominal imaging (ultrasound or Doppler of the portal, splenic and mesenteric veins) and the cause of her pain.

unknowns.zh-CN: “巨核细胞172个、产板型100个”和网状纤维“±”背后的骨髓细节（增生程度、巨核细胞形态、纤维化分级）；JAK2突变负荷；另一项融合基因是什么；CALR和MPL；核型标本来源。
unknowns.en: The marrow details behind “172 megakaryocytes, 100 platelet-producing” and reticulin “±” (cellularity, megakaryocyte morphology, fibrosis grade); the JAK2 allele burden; which second fusion was tested; CALR and MPL; the karyotype specimen.

unknowns.zh-CN: 入院前用的是什么抗生素；羟基脲、干扰素和阿司匹林的剂量、制剂、开始日期和先后顺序，以及“等”还包括哪些药。
unknowns.en: The antibiotics given before admission; the doses, preparations, start days and order of hydroxyurea, interferon and aspirin, and what else the report's “among others” includes.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 儿童血小板增多：绝大多数是反应性的（感染、缺铁、炎症），但计数持续超过1000×10⁹/L、治疗诱因后不降、CRP不高、脾可触及、白细胞升高，就要寻找原发病因：血涂片、铁代谢、BCR::ABL1和驱动基因、骨髓；遗传性血小板增多（THPO、MPL胚系变异）也在鉴别之列（GTH/GPOH THROMKID-Plus，Ann Hematol 2021；BSH 2010血小板增多指南）。本例计数1905和1497×10⁹/L、CRP<8 mg/L、脾肋下2 cm、白细胞27.29×10⁹/L，入院前却先用了一个疗程抗感染药。
teachingPoints.en: Raised platelets in a child: most are reactive (infection, iron deficiency, inflammation), but a count that stays above 1000 × 10⁹/L after the trigger is treated, with a low CRP, a palpable spleen and a raised white count, sends the child for a primary work-up — film, iron status, BCR::ABL1 and driver mutations, marrow — with hereditary thrombocytosis (germline THPO or MPL variants) in the differential (GTH/GPOH THROMKID-Plus, Ann Hematol 2021; BSH 2010 thrombocytosis guideline). Here: 1905 and 1497 × 10⁹/L, CRP < 8 mg/L, spleen 2 cm, white cells 27.29 × 10⁹/L — after a course of antibiotics had come first.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 先看出血再谈抗血栓：血小板超过约1000×10⁹/L时可丢失大分子VWF多聚体，造成获得性血管性血友病综合征；她的APTT 52.3 s、纤维蛋白原1.84 g/L需要对照本实验室的范围解释，在阿司匹林或有创操作之前查VWF抗原、活性和Ⅷ因子，活性低时先降血小板（Tiede等，Blood 2011）；计数超过1000×10⁹/L时，瑞斯托霉素辅因子活性高于30%才可用抗血小板药（Stockklausner等，Ann Hematol 2021）。报告用过阿司匹林（开始时间没有记录）；现在应等VWF结果。16岁以下儿童只有在有明确指征时才用阿司匹林（英国MHRA，2003）：遇水痘或流感要停药就诊（瑞氏综合征），流感疫苗用灭活疫苗，鼻喷减毒活疫苗不能用于正在服阿司匹林的孩子。
teachingPoints.en: Bleeding before antithrombotics: above about 1000 × 10⁹/L the largest VWF multimers can be lost (acquired von Willebrand syndrome). Her APTT of 52.3 s and fibrinogen of 1.84 g/L need reading against the laboratory's own ranges, and VWF antigen, activity and factor VIII are checked before aspirin or any procedure, lowering the count first when activity is low (Tiede et al., Blood 2011); above 1000 × 10⁹/L an antiplatelet drug needs a ristocetin cofactor activity above 30 % (Stockklausner et al., Ann Hematol 2021). The report gave aspirin (start not recorded); today it waits for VWF. Under 16, aspirin is used only for a specific indication (UK MHRA, 2003): it is stopped during chickenpox or flu (Reye's syndrome), and the flu vaccine is the inactivated one — the live nasal vaccine is not given to a child on aspirin.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 分类（WHO第5版，2022，沿用此前标准）：原发性血小板增多症要求血小板≥450×10⁹/L、以大而成熟、核分叶多的巨核细胞增生为主的骨髓、排除BCR::ABL1阳性慢性髓系白血病、真性红细胞增多症、原发性骨髓纤维化等，并有JAK2、CALR或MPL突变。本例JAK2 V617F阳性、BCR::ABL1阴性、核型46,XX，但血红蛋白没有记录，骨髓描述缺巨核细胞形态和增生程度；而白细胞≥11×10⁹/L和可触及的脾脏是纤维化前期骨髓纤维化的次要标准——2013年报告的诊断，今天需要骨髓复核来确认。
teachingPoints.en: Classification (WHO 5th edition, 2022, keeping the earlier criteria): essential thrombocythaemia needs platelets ≥ 450 × 10⁹/L, a marrow dominated by large, mature, hyperlobulated megakaryocytes, exclusion of BCR::ABL1-positive CML, polycythaemia vera, primary myelofibrosis and other myeloid neoplasms, and a JAK2, CALR or MPL mutation. Here JAK2 V617F was positive, BCR::ABL1 negative and the karyotype 46,XX, but the haemoglobin is not recorded and the marrow report lacks megakaryocyte morphology and cellularity — while white cells ≥ 11 × 10⁹/L and a palpable spleen are minor criteria for prefibrotic myelofibrosis. The 2013 label needs a marrow review today.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 治疗（儿童无共识，成人证据外推）：降细胞治疗用于高危疾病（ELN 2018），一线为羟基脲或聚乙二醇干扰素α（Tefferi等，Am J Hematol 2024），年轻患者常首选干扰素；PT-1试验（809例高危成人，NEJM 2005）中阿那格雷加阿司匹林的动脉血栓、严重出血和骨髓纤维化转化都多于羟基脲加阿司匹林。成人BSH 2010方案把血小板>1500×10⁹/L列为高危，修订版IPSET却会把一个年轻、无血栓的JAK2阳性者列为低危——两者都没有在儿童中验证。报告用了羟基脲、干扰素和阿司匹林等（剂量和先后顺序没有记录），第15天降至559×10⁹/L；现在选一种一线药，阿司匹林等VWF。
teachingPoints.en: Treatment (no paediatric consensus; adult evidence extrapolated): cytoreduction is for high-risk disease (ELN 2018), with hydroxyurea or pegylated interferon-α first line (Tefferi et al., Am J Hematol 2024) and interferon often preferred in the young; in PT-1 (809 high-risk adults, NEJM 2005) anagrelide plus aspirin gave more arterial thrombosis, serious haemorrhage and myelofibrotic transformation than hydroxyurea plus aspirin. The adult BSH 2010 scheme counts platelets > 1500 × 10⁹/L as high risk, while the revised IPSET would call a young, JAK2-positive patient without thrombosis low risk — neither is validated in children. The report gave hydroxyurea, interferon and aspirin, among others (doses and order not recorded; 559 × 10⁹/L by day 15); today, one first-line drug, with aspirin waiting for VWF.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 惊厥：骨髓增殖性肿瘤、血小板极高的孩子新出现惊厥，先按动脉缺血性卒中、静脉窦血栓或出血处理——查气道和血糖、复查血象和凝血、暂停抗血小板药，脑影像在到院1小时内完成（疑似卒中，RCPCH 2017），诊断不明时做MRI并包括静脉和动脉成像；一次短暂、已停止的惊厥在原因不明前不急于用抗癫痫药，也不先做腰穿。报告的增强MRI未见异常，但序列没有记录；单个病例不能把惊厥归因于疾病还是药物。
teachingPoints.en: The seizure: in a child with a myeloproliferative neoplasm and an extreme count, a new seizure is an arterial ischaemic stroke, a venous sinus thrombosis or a bleed first — airway and glucose, a repeat count and clotting, antiplatelet drugs held, brain imaging within 1 hour of arrival for a suspected stroke (RCPCH 2017), with MRI including venous and arterial sequences when the diagnosis is uncertain; no rushed antiseizure drug after one brief seizure that has stopped, and no lumbar puncture first. The report's contrast MRI was normal, but its sequences are not recorded, and one case cannot pin the seizure on the disease or on a drug.
